summary: Buenaventura filed a Form 6-K with its first quarter 2026 earnings results, reporting financial and operational highlights such as an 8% increase in gold production and net income of US$ 335.4 million. The filing is a routine earnings release with no special situation elements like acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. It includes standard disclosures on production, EBITDA, and dividends received from Cerro Verde. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. As a foreign issuer filing earnings under Rule 13a-16, this is equivalent to a routine US quarterly report and does not trigger a special situation classification.
